report: Revision pairing theorem T3 (SPEC section 9, the Kohn-Sham level), verified exactly in WolframScript

checks.name: T3_block_hamiltonian_map
checks.detail: for arbitrary functions M(y), kappa(y), v(y), any k, any hidden scale f > 0 and both block types j = +-1: h_(-j)(-M, k, v) (sigma2 chi) = sigma2 h_j(M, k, v) chi as differential operators (chi = (c1(y), c2(y)) arbitrary); so h_j(M) chi = eps chi iff h_(-j)(-M) (sigma2 chi) = eps (sigma2 chi): equal eigenvalue eps, same k, same potential v. Control: without M -> -M the identity fails

checks.name: T3_ode_map
checks.detail: the shooting form chi' = f N chi with N = M_eff sigma3 - kappa k sigma2 + i j (eps - v_v) sigma1 (ks-theory.json blockEquation.ode): sigma2 N_j(M, k, eps) sigma2 = N_(-j)(-M, k, eps) exactly, so sigma2 maps solutions of the block-j ODE with M onto solutions of the block-(-j) ODE with -M at the same eps

checks.name: T3_tip_condition_map
checks.detail: tip condition (1 - Q(theta)) chi(-L) = 0, Q(theta) = Cos[theta] sigma3 + Sin[theta] sigma2 (ks-theory.json boundaryConditions.tip): sigma2 Q(theta) sigma2 = Q(Pi - theta), so chi obeys the tip condition with theta iff sigma2 chi obeys it with Pi - theta; the canonical theta = 0 (chi2(-L) = 0) goes to theta = Pi (chi1(-L) = 0). Negative control: the image of (1, 0) violates the UNtransformed condition theta = 0

checks.name: T3_fold_conditions_exchanged
checks.detail: the fold (ks-theory.json boundaryConditions.fold: the fold cos z = 0 joins the two halves of a cell, a spinor continuous across it has the same chi(y) on both halves, so there is no mirror copy; the record fills both fold conditions, theta = 0: chi2(0) = 0 and theta = Pi: chi1(0) = 0, w = 1/2, ASSUMED), i.e. (1 -+ gamma^(x0)) chi(0) = 0 with gamma^(x0) = sigma3 in every block; sigma2 (1 - sigma3) sigma2 = 1 + sigma3, so the map exchanges the two fold conditions (both are solved and filled together, so the set of boundary problems is mapped onto itself); the boundary current -i j phi^dagger sigma1 chi (selfAdjointness) and the norm chi^dagger chi are invariant under (chi, j) -> (sigma2 chi, -j): current-killing ends stay current-killing, the image block operator is self-adjoint with real levels

checks.name: T3_orbital_densities
checks.detail: per orbital (ks-theory.json densities.perOrbital): n_o = chi^dagger chi, s_o = chi^dagger j sigma2 chi, t_o = chi^dagger j sigma3 chi (current along k-hat), q_o = chi^dagger sigma3 chi, c_o = chi^dagger j sigma1 chi; under (chi, j) -> (sigma2 chi, -j) at the same k: n_o -> n_o, s_o -> -s_o, t_o -> t_o, q_o -> -q_o, c_o -> c_o (exact for arbitrary complex chi, both j); hence n(y) and t(y) are even, S(y) and Q(y) odd under the map

checks.name: T3_mean_field_map
checks.detail: Kohn-Sham potentials READ from ks-theory.json exchange.kohnShamPotentials (Hartree plus the exact uniform-gas exchange): M_eff = m + c_M lambda S, v_v = c_v lambda n, e_int = c_S lambda S^2 + c_n lambda n^2 with c_M = 15/16 (Meff_coefficient_of_lambda_S), c_v = -1/16 (vv_coefficient_of_lambda_n), c_S = 15/32 and c_n = -1/32 (parsed from the stated formula e_int). Consistency: these are the values of hypothesis H2 (15/16, -1/16, 15/32, -1/32); the two coefficients agree with the stated formulas Meff and vv of the same record; M_eff - m = d e_int/dS and v_v = d e_int/dn. Map (S -> -S, n -> n), with v_v written as a function v_v(m, lambda, n, S) of the four arguments of the self-consistency loop: M_eff[-m, +lambda, -S] = -M_eff[m, lambda, S], v_v(-m, +lambda, n, -S) = v_v(m, lambda, n, S) (its value at the image arguments equals its value at the original ones), e_int[lambda, n, -S] = e_int[lambda, n, S]. So the self-consistency loop commutes with the map exactly when the image carries (-m, +lambda). Control with (-m, -lambda): M_eff[-m, -lambda, -S] differs from -M_eff[m, lambda, S] (by 2 c_M lambda S) and v_v(-m, -lambda, n, -S) differs from v_v(m, lambda, n, S) (by -2 c_v lambda n)

checks.name: T3_energies_and_emt_profiles_equal
checks.detail: for arbitrary occupied orbitals of both block types (general complex chi, eps, occupation f, degeneracy g, momentum k, weight w of the two fold conditions) the pointwise energy density rho = sum w g f eps n_o - e_int, the pressures p3 = sum w g f (kappa |k|/3) t_o + e_int, p_t = e_int, p0 = sum w g f [(eps - v_v) n_o - M_eff s_o - kappa |k| t_o] + e_int (ks-theory.json emt), the integrand of E_KS = sum g f eps - 2 Vol_7 int e^(3Hy) e_int, the entropy terms and the exact-Fock diagnostic e_int + (lambda/32) Q^2 are EQUAL for the image state with (-m, +lambda), while S and Q change sign (control: with (-m, -lambda) the E_KS integrand differs). Levels eps and occupations f are carried over unchanged, so the Mermin chemical potential, N, the entropy, the grand potential Omega = -T sum g ln(1 + e^(-(eps - mu)/T)) - 2 Vol_7 int e^(3Hy) e_int and F = Omega + mu N are equal too

checks.name: T3_exact_k0_spectra
checks.detail: k = 0, v = 0, constant M (ks-theory.json boundaryConditions.exactK0Spectra): with chi(y) = exp(N y) chi(0), N = M sigma3 + i j eps sigma1, N^2 = (M^2 - eps^2) I, the characteristic function of (M, j, even parity, theta = 0) is minus that of (-M, -j, odd parity, theta = Pi), and that of (M, j, odd, theta = 0) equals that of (-M, -j, even, theta = Pi), identically in eps, M, L (both j): the two problems have the same spectrum level by level (even: eps = 0 and eps^2 = M^2 + (n Pi/L)^2; odd: tan(p L) = -p/M). The zero mode (E^(M y), 0) goes to (0, i E^(M y)), the zero mode of the image problem. Control: the image with the UNtransformed tip theta = 0 has a different characteristic function (Cosh[p L] + M Sinh[p L]/p type), i.e. a different spectrum

checks.name: T3_Gamma_is_the_block_map
checks.detail: with the unitary block basis V of ks-theory.json (rows = spinor components Psi_0..Psi_15) and Gamma = gamma^(x0) gamma^(x1) ... gamma^(x7) = diag(-I8, I8) of gammas.json: Gamma V_(j,s2,s3) = V_(-j,s2,s3) (s2 sigma2) for all 8 blocks, and in every block gamma^(x0) = sigma3, gamma^(x0) gamma^(x4) = j sigma1: the 2 x 2 map (chi, j) -> (sigma2 chi, -j) of T3 is the chirality Gamma of the 16-component Kohn-Sham orbital Psi_16 = e^(-i eps x4) e^(i k x1) e^(-(3/2) H y) e^(a4/2) b4^(-1) V_beta chi(y)/sqrt(ell^3 v_t) (ks-theory.json sectorAndAnsatz.orbital16; up to the phase s2), applied at the same point; Gamma is constant, so the map commutes with the half-density factor e^(-(3/2) H y) e^(a4/2) b4^(-1) of the corrected metric
